Only manufacturers quoting for goods/product manufactured by them shall be eligible for availing benefits under the Public Procurement Poli cy for MSEs order 2012. (d) Type “Nuclear Power Corporation of India” in search bar. (e) Select “Tamilnadu” as State in filter option in State tab.
